# Not every installed package ships to production. See which ones do.

> Free, no-signup, no-upload tool that reads a package-lock.json in your browser and shows which npm dependencies reach your deployed app versus which are build- or test-only. Runs entirely client-side.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [This tool vs. npm audit](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/npm-deployment-evidence/vs-npm-audit.html)
